description: Flight fares for one route and date, one-way or round trip: the cheapest, the fastest and the cheapest nonstop option, then up to 20 itineraries sorted by price with carrier, stops, duration, departure and arrival times (local and UTC), every flight segment and aircraft. Cabin, maximum stops and market (sets the currency) are optional. Fares for a single traveller from Ignav; a fare search, not a booking. Price: $0.05 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

date.description: Departure date YYYY-MM-DD (today to 330 days ahead)

from.description: Departure airport, 3-letter IATA code, e.g. IST

market.description: 2-letter country code that sets the currency, default US (USD); e.g. GB, DE, TR

return.description: Return date YYYY-MM-DD for a round trip (optional)

to.description: Arrival airport, 3-letter IATA code, e.g. LHR

name: flights
title: Flights
